definitions.explanation: What one thinks or feels about something, set out formally, especially in a statement by someone in an official position, such as a company president's New Year message.

examples.japanese: ⟦{社長|しゃちょう}→社長：01428_shachou⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{年頭|ねんとう}→年頭：21721_nentou⟧{所感|しょかん}。
⟦{研修|けんしゅう}→研修：05322_kenshuu⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{所感|しょかん}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{述|の}べる→述べる：02389_noberu⟧。
examples.english: To give one's impressions of the training.

examples.japanese: ⟦{首相|しゅしょう}→首相：03217_shushou⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{会見|かいけん}→会見：11447_kaiken⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{冒頭|ぼうとう}→冒頭：11725_boutou⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧、⟦{選挙|せんきょ}→選挙：03303_senkyo⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{結果|けっか}→結果：02486_kekka⟧⟦について→〜について：03103_nitsuite⟧{所感|しょかん}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{語|かた}った→語る：01930_kataru⟧。
examples.english: At the start of the press conference, the prime minister shared some thoughts on the election results.

notes:
COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- ⟦{年頭|ねんとう}→年頭：21721_nentou⟧{所感|しょかん}: New Year's address (by a leader or company head)
- {所感|しょかん}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{述|の}べる→述べる：02389_noberu⟧: to state one's impressions
- ⟦{研修|けんしゅう}→研修：05322_kenshuu⟧{所感|しょかん}: a written report of one's impressions of a training course

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{感想|かんそう}→感想：00450_kansou⟧: impressions, thoughts (everyday word: ⟦{映画|えいが}→映画：02273_eiga⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{感想|かんそう}→感想：00450_kansou⟧). {所感|しょかん} is the formal, official counterpart.
- {所見|しょけん}: findings, opinion (of a doctor or expert)
